_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. digg.com declares its design-token layer in its stylesheets (raw/css-vars.json): theme-invariant scales under core.* and every theme-switching name — the Tailwind hue scales and the shadcn semantics (--background, --primary, --accent, --border, --input, --ring, --sidebar-*) — emitted under both light.* and dark.* so each theme resolves its own value. Both themes are really painted signed out: the dark roles below are measured through the sidebar theme pill's System -> Light -> Dark cycle. lab()/oklab()/oklch() colour vars are normalised to hex. Measured roles alias to the declared values where they match.
